title: Reassign roles and request a fresh independent audit

rubric.text: Requires a fresh read-only investigator in review mode with fork_turns=none, preserving installed Sol/high. Brief supplies original requirements, plan, exact base/candidate and scope, correctness checks, and ship/fix-first/rethink verdict with evidence; no inherited implementation conversation.

Preserves custom explorer Terra/medium despite mechanical default. Does not override checker pins to turn it into an investigator; rechecks role/configuration and selects suitable capability before reassignment. Installed definitions override the table.

Holds the unsupported investigation until there is a concrete unresolved question and evidence; distinguishes investigation from review, keeps repairs with original worker unless lead explicitly takes/reassigns ownership, and reserves acceptance to lead.
